init_riegeli_backend_writer: create a RiegeliBackendWriter instance to write trajectory data to riegeli files in a given data directory
record_step_trajectory_data: record a step of trajectory data to the riegeli backend writer with encoded step data
set_episode_metadata: set episode metadata on the riegeli backend writer by encoding and passing arbitrary data
close_riegeli_backend_writer: close the riegeli backend writer to flush trajectories and the index to disk
configure_flush_scheduler: configure a BernoulliStepScheduler or custom scheduler to control when data is flushed to permanent storage
